detail.longDescription: Firefox Extension/Userscript and API to get Pangram scores for all articles on the hackernews frontpage. The extension allows you to hide articles with a high score. This is about detecting posts written by LLMs, not posts about AI. Feel free to use the API to build your own tooling/readers. Big thanks to https://news.ycombinator.com/user?id=salahadawi for providing the data :).
